caption: What if Earth were as big as Jupiter? Jupiter is about 11 times wider than Earth. Keep Earth made of the same dense rock but stretch it to that size, and surface gravity gets about 11 times stronger. A 60 kg person would feel like 660 kg. Fighter pilots handle about 9 g only in short bursts, and at 11 g blood struggles to reach your brain. A 90 m six in cricket would land only about 8 m away. The surface would be about 120 times bigger, so India alone would be nearly 80% of the size of today's whole Earth, and Delhi to Mumbai by road would be about 15,000 km. Escaping into space would need over 120 km/s instead of 11.2 km/s. The twist: real Jupiter's gravity is only about 2.6 times Earth's, because it's mostly light hydrogen and helium. Could YOU survive 11 g? 👇
